gamma.cp: adj. vulgar; what should be understood or attained.
gamma.p: [Gāma+ṇya] (ti) CL=8 Gāma+ya. Gāme bhavo gammo. Rū,nhā.231-2.]  it is being/happening in village, the property of a person who lived in village (sexual relations habbit). Gamma(na) [gamu+ṇya. Gamu+ya. Nīti,sutta.1129. Nīti,dhā.205.moga,pañcikā,5.30.] . (1) going. (Ti) (2) should be gone.
